data.title: 红莲 · 隐秘温泉的耳鬓厮磨
data.description: 夜色缭绕的竹林私人露天温泉中，滚烫泉水漫过腰际。湿透的雪白马尾贴在泛红的美背上，红莲主动跨坐入怀紧紧相拥，把滚烫的脸颊深深埋入你的颈窝低喘。
data.location: secluded outdoor natural hot spring surrounded by bamboo and night mist
data.action: soaking in hot spring steam, wet white ponytail clinging to flushed back, embracing partner closely, warm water lapping waist, breathless whisper
data.lighting: steamy moonlit mist illuminated by subtle stone lanterns
data.mood: steamy sensual warmth, deep emotional resonance, passionate embrace
data.promptProse: Embracing closely in a steamy outdoor hot spring, Scarlet clings tight with wet white hair and flushed skin under the moonlit mist.
data.animaCaption: Scarlet embracing tenderly in a secluded steamy hot spring under moonlight.
